title: Mastering Algebra for WAEC
subject: Mathematics
description: Variables, equations, quadratics & word problems — WAEC style.

lessons.title: Linear Equations
lessons.body: An equation like 2x + 3 = 11 solves to x = 4. Steps: subtract 3, divide by 2. Practice rearranging formulas — WAEC loves this.

lessons.title: Quadratic Equations
lessons.body: Factorise x²+5x+6 = (x+2)(x+3). Roots: -2, -3. Also learn completing the square and the almighty formula.

lessons.title: Word Problems
lessons.body: Translate English to maths: 'thrice a number less 4 is 11' → 3x-4=11 → x=5. Always define x first.

title: JAMB English: Comprehension & Lexis
subject: English
description: Speed reading, synonyms/antonyms, concord and registers.

lessons.title: Reading Strategy
lessons.body: Skim first, read questions, scan for answers. 1 min per question max — move on and return.

lessons.title: Synonyms & Antonyms
lessons.body: Learn word roots: 'bene-' good, 'mal-' bad, 'pre-' before. Builds 100s of words fast.

title: Physics: Motion & Waves
subject: Physics
description: Speed, velocity, acceleration, projectile + wave basics.

lessons.title: Equations of Motion
lessons.body: v=u+at, s=ut+½at², v²=u²+2as. Memorise all three — derive units to check.

lessons.title: Waves
lessons.body: v=fλ. Transverse vs longitudinal. Sound needs a medium; light does not.

lessons.title: The Cell
lessons.body: Mitochondria = powerhouse. Ribosomes make protein. Nucleus holds DNA. WAEC diagrams: label them!

lessons.title: Equilibrium
lessons.body: Where demand = supply. A price rise causes contraction of demand but extension of supply.
